title: About XYZ Hotel & Heritage Legacy
content: XYZ Hotel is a prestigious 5-star luxury hotel established in 1987 in New Delhi's Central Diplomatic Enclave. It features 350+ luxury rooms, 5 fine restaurants, and 37 years of exemplary hospitality blending timeless royal heritage with contemporary sophistication.

title: Location & Proximity
content: XYZ Hotel is located at 1 Royal Avenue, Central Diplomatic Enclave, New Delhi, India 110001. The hotel is situated in the heart of the diplomatic district, just 20 minutes drive from Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL), close to major embassies, historic landmarks, and luxury boutiques.

title: Deluxe King Room Specifications & Tariff
content: Deluxe King Room is priced at ₹12,500 per night (plus 18% GST). It offers 48 m² (516 sq.ft) of space with panoramic city skyline views, a plush king pillow-top bed, Italian marble bathroom with deep soaking tub and rainforest shower, Nespresso coffee atelier, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi 6.

title: Premier Skyline Suite Specifications & Tariff
content: Premier Skyline Suite is priced at ₹28,000 per night (plus 18% GST). It spans 75 m² (807 sq.ft) and includes a distinct living salon, walk-in dressing wardrobe, dedicated 24/7 personal butler service, complimentary evening cocktails and canapé service, and exclusive Club Lounge privileges.

title: The Presidential Royal Suite Specifications & Tariff
content: The Presidential Royal Suite is priced at ₹65,000 per night (plus 18% GST). Located on the top 32nd penthouse floor, it offers 180 m² (1,937 sq.ft) of royal luxury, private rooftop terrace, 10-seat private dining salon, grand piano, curated fine art collection, private chef and dedicated butler, bespoke fragrance bar, and complimentary Rolls-Royce airport chauffeur transfer.

title: Garden Plunge Pool Villa Specifications & Tariff
content: Garden Plunge Pool Villa is priced at ₹42,000 per night (plus 18% GST). It features 95 m² (1,022 sq.ft) of secluded haven within heritage gardens, private heated plunge pool, outdoor teak sun deck, daybed pavilion, daily champagne breakfast, and full spa bath menu.

title: The Saffron Pavilion — Royal Awadhi Haute Cuisine
content: The Saffron Pavilion offers Royal Awadhi and Mughlai heritage cuisine prepared in artisanal copper tandoors and slow dum pukht clay vessels. Timings: Lunch 12:30 PM to 3:30 PM, Dinner 7:00 PM to 11:30 PM. Dress code is Smart Elegant or Traditional Formal. Two Imperial Salons seat 8 and 14 guests for private dining. Direct reservation phone: +91 123 456 7891.

title: Aura Vista — Sky Lounge & Rooftop Bar
content: Aura Vista is a 30th-floor rooftop lounge and cocktail bar offering 360-degree panoramic skyline views. Features Modern Pan-Asian robatayaki, sushi, and botanical mixology cocktails. Timings: Daily 5:00 PM to 1:30 AM (Sundowners from 5:00 PM). Dress code: Sophisticated Chic. Features ambient live jazz. Direct lounge phone: +91 123 456 7892.

title: L'Orangerie & Curated Wine Cellar
content: L'Orangerie is a French Mediterranean fine dining destination led by Michelin-trained Chef Laurent Moreau. Offers multi-course degustation tasting menus and cellar consultations with our Head Sommelier covering over 1,200 rare Grand Cru wines. Timings: Dinner only 6:30 PM to 11:00 PM (Closed Mondays). Dress code: Formal Jacket Preferred.

title: The Grand Conservatory — 24-Hour Brasserie & High Tea
content: The Grand Conservatory is an all-day dining botanical atrium operating 24 hours daily. Serves morning champagne buffet breakfasts, international gourmet fare, wood-fired artisanal pizzas, and legendary Royal English High Tea service from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM accompanied by live classical harp.

title: Curated Add-ons & Packages
content: Guests can enhance their reservation with three signature add-on experiences: 1) Royal Champagne Breakfast Buffet at The Grand Conservatory: +₹2,500 per night for 2 guests. 2) Luxury Mercedes Airport Chauffeur Transfer (Roundtrip VIP airport meet & greet): +₹4,500 total. 3) 60-Minute Couples Ayurvedic Aromatherapy Spa treatment: +₹8,500 total.

title: Promotional & Loyalty Discount Codes
content: Online guests can enter promo code 'XYZLUXURY', 'TAJROYAL', or 'WELCOME15' at checkout to receive an instant 15% discount on their room subtotal. The discount is computed dynamically before luxury GST.

title: Offline Telephone & WhatsApp Booking Desk
content: XYZ Hotel provides 24/7 direct offline booking support modeled after premier luxury chains like Taj and Radisson. Guests can call the 24/7 toll-free reservation desk at 1800 123 4567 or direct line +91 123 456 7890. WhatsApp instant booking concierge is reachable at +91 98765 43210. Offline bookings support personalized suite holds, bank wire transfers, pay-at-property options, and instant callback requests within 15 minutes.

title: Check-In, Check-Out & Early Arrival Policies
content: Standard check-in time is 2:00 PM and standard check-out time is 12:00 PM (noon). Early check-in and late check-out can be requested in advance and are subject to availability or pre-arranged through the Golden Keys (Clefs d'Or) concierge desk.

title: Cancellation, Modification & Refund Policy
content: Reservations may be cancelled or modified without penalty up to 24 hours prior to 2:00 PM on the scheduled arrival date. For cancellations made within 24 hours or in the event of a no-show, one night's room charge applies. Peak festive season or presidential penthouse bookings have tailored deposit terms confirmed during reservation.

title: Wellness, Spa, Vitality Pool & Fitness
content: XYZ Hotel features an expansive Ayurvedic spa sanctuary, Himalayan pink salt inhalation rooms, heated indoor vitality pools, open-air morning yoga pavilions with yoga masters, and a 24-hour Technogym fitness center with personal trainers.

title: 24/7 Clefs d'Or Concierge & Butler Privileges
content: All suites include dedicated 24-hour butler service for packing, unpacking, private dining setups, and shoe shine. Our international Clefs d'Or concierge arranges private historical monument tours, VIP gallery access, helicopter charters, and luxury chauffeur transfers.
